pre_registered_constants.note: All constants are pre-registered. No data-driven tuning allowed.

claim_classes.photometric OCS: Features derived from OCS photometric values. Sub-types: (a) Direct OCS or OCS ratios/logs (baseline/R/I/L groups) — pure photometric, no pixel-count dependency. (b) OCS photometric values normalized by visibility pixel counts (N/M3/M4 groups containing density features) — photometric signal modulated by geometry. Positive results from sub-type (a) can be attributed to pure OCS photometric channel; positive results from sub-type (b) must be described as 'OCS photometric values normalized by visibility pixel counts' and cannot claim independence from visibility information.
claim_classes.visibility control: Features derived from pixel-count / visibility fields only. No OCS photometric values. Used to isolate geometry/visibility contribution from photometric contribution. Positive results CANNOT be attributed to OCS photometric channel.
claim_classes.mixed OCS+visibility: Features combining photometric OCS and visibility/pixel-count fields. Positive results MUST be decomposed by channel — cannot be attributed to a single channel without additional ablation.
claim_classes.constant sanity check: Feature expected to be constant in phase63 fixed-roll data (sun_dir and det_dir are dataset-wide constants). Used only for C1 code self-check. Does NOT participate in C2 evaluation. If output is non-constant, code has a bug.

configs.description: Baseline: raw 4-dim integrated OCS. Control reference for all other configs.
Per-part/total ratios for two main parts. Scale-invariant. Excludes yinshenban (near-zero OCS).
Per-part/total ratios for all three parts. Includes yinshenban (may be near-constant).
Inter-part OCS ratio: jinshuzhuti / taiyangnengban. Eliminates total as intermediate variable.
Per-pixel average OCS (OCS photometric values normalized by visibility pixel counts). Positive results represent photometric signal modulated by geometry, not pure photometric-only evidence.
Log-stabilized ratios. Compresses dynamic range, symmetrizes ratios.
Compact combination: raw ratios + log-stabilized ratios.
Compact combination: per-pixel densities (visibility-normalized) + raw ratios. Includes OCS photometric values normalized by visibility pixel counts.

Extended combination: log features + density features + raw ratios. Includes OCS photometric values normalized by visibility pixel counts; positive results must not be claimed as pure photometric-only evidence.
Pure visibility/pixel-fraction features. Zero OCS photometric information. Tests whether geometry alone enables cross-yaw generalization.
Extended visibility-only. Includes yinshenban fraction. Pure geometry control.
Mixed: photometric OCS ratios + visibility pixel fractions. If positive, requires decomposition of OCS vs visibility contribution.
Maximum non-geometric information. Combines all photometric OCS derived features + visibility features. Highest dimension (13). Risk of overfitting for OCS-only MLP on ~1850 training samples.

Constant sanity check. phase_angle_cos = dot(sun_dir, det_dir). EXPECTED CONSTANT in phase63 fixed-roll data (sun_dir and det_dir are dataset-wide constants). If output is non-constant, the feature extraction code has a bug. Does NOT participate in C2 evaluation.

sanity_check_expected.pass_message: PASS: phase_angle_cos is constant (as expected in phase63 fixed-roll).
sanity_check_expected.fail_message: WARNING: phase_angle_cos has >1 unique values. Expected constant. Check sun_dir/det_dir extraction logic.

c2_evaluation_note: Only configs with c2_participant=true (config_id 1-13) participate in C2 screening. constant_check_1d is excluded from C2 evaluation — it is only for C1 code self-check.
